test_float_parser: test the float parser reads scientific notation, infinity, and decimal values from CSV data
test_scientific_no_exponent: test the CSV parser handles scientific notation strings without exponents like 2e, 3E, 42e
test_large_exponent: test the parser correctly handles extremely large and small exponents producing zero or infinity
test_precise_xstrtod_large_mantissa: test the C parser preserves precision for 17-digit mantissas near 2^53 with high float precision
test_invalid_float_number: test the parser treats invalid float strings like 81e31d04049863b72 as literal strings instead of numbers
